title: Xanthe and the Veil
premise: When the border wards of Thornfell collapse and the stars vanish, exiled storm-caller Odile Delacroix discovers her homeland has been erased from the world's memory — a country sealed behind the Veil by an ancient bargain her own bloodline struck. Guided by Xanthe, a cartographer who can still remember the unmapped roads, Odile must reach the Door of the Thirteenth Moon before it closes, choosing between restoring her inheritance as Thornfell's last storm-warden or tearing down the Veil to free everyone trapped inside. In the end, Odile sacrifices her claim to the storm-throne, unmaking the bargain so that Thornfell exists not as a hidden kingdom but as a free road open to all, while she and Xanthe walk out together under newly returned stars.
about_author: I. M. Zhou is the pen name of a former mountain guide who spent a decade mapping passes across three countries before turning to fiction. They write fantasy rooted in borders, weather, and the people who live in between.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Smuggling a cargo through Thornfell's high passes, Odile feels the border wards shatter and watches every star extinguish at once. The emotional beat is dread sharpened into resolve: whatever broke, she knows these mountains better than anyone alive.

chapters.title: A Cartographer with No Country
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Xanthe arrives at Odile's camp carrying maps of roads that officially don't exist, insisting Thornfell still stands behind a veil no one else can see. Beat: wary alliance between two liars who recognize each other.

chapters.title: What the Wards Remember
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the ruined ward-stone, Odile touches residual magic and glimpses her grandmother sealing the border — and hears her own name spoken in the spell. Beat: inheritance revealed as burden, not gift.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. A dying warden explains the moon will complete a thirteenth turn before the Veil hardens permanently; after that, everyone inside is erased. Beat: the clock starts, and grief for a homeland already half-forgotten.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Logic
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile plans their route like a run: back roads, dead drops, old bribes — but the contacts she meets have forgotten her face mid-conversation. Beat: loneliness of being remembered by no one but your enemy.

chapters.title: The Hollow King's Toll
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. In a valley village, the self-styled Hollow King taxes travelers' memories; Xanthe pays with a childhood to protect Odile's secret. Beat: love shown through quiet sacrifice neither will name.

chapters.title: Storms Without Thunder
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile's storm-calling fails inside the Veil — her power belongs to the country that disowned her. She rages, then notices the storms here are silent, waiting. Beat: humiliation curdling into curiosity.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Ice
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. In a frozen archive, they find the original bargain: Thornfell's rulers traded their kingdom's existence for immunity from a devouring war. Beat: truth vs. loyalty crystallizes — the Veil was mercy, and a cage.

chapters.title: Blood in the Ledger
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The bargain names House Delacroix as its keepers; Odile's exile was engineered to hide the heir from those who'd use her. Beat: betrayal by family, and the first temptation to simply take the throne and let the Veil stand.

chapters.title: The Wardens' Remnant
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Surviving wardens offer Odile the crown if she'll renew the bargain; they've kept a shadow-Thornfell alive inside the Veil for a generation. Beat: duty wearing the mask of home.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Night Market
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. A black market where the forgotten trade in stolen memories; Odile buys back one of Xanthe's paid-away years and learns what Xanthe gave up. Beat: tenderness that changes the stakes from survival to devotion.

chapters.title: The Road That Eats Itself
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Their map-route begins erasing itself behind them; the Veil is digesting the way out. Xanthe must draw a road that never existed. Beat: the cartographer's art pushed past its limits, fear transmuted into creation.

chapters.title: What the Hollow King Kept
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Confronting the Hollow King, Odile recovers his hoard of memories — including her mother's final night, revealing the Door of the Thirteenth Moon is real and guarded by the original bargain itself. Beat: fury and clarity.

chapters.title: Halfway to Nowhere
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Ambushed by wardens who want the heir silenced, Xanthe takes a wound meant for Odile and confesses: they were sent to find her, then chose her instead. Beat: loyalty vs. truth detonates between them.

chapters.title: The Silent Storm Breaks
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Grief and anger crack the Veil's hold on Odile's magic; the silent storms answer her at last, because they were always hers — the country's power waiting for its keeper. Beat: power reclaimed on her own terms.

chapters.title: Terms of Surrender
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Odile offers the wardens a choice: crown her and renew the cage, or follow her to the Door and end the bargain forever. Some kneel; some draw steel. Beat: leadership forged from refusal.

chapters.title: The Door of the Thirteenth Moon
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. They reach the Door as the thirteenth turn nears full; the bargain's guardian wears Odile's grandmother's face and offers her everything she lost. Beat: the climax's threshold — desire dressed as destiny.

chapters.title: Inheritance Refused
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. At the Door, Odile must speak the renewal or the unmaking; Xanthe reminds her what a country is worth versus what freedom costs. Odile speaks the unmaking. Beat: love against duty resolved — she chooses the living over the legacy.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. The Veil tears; the war-devourer the bargain imprisoned wakes, and Odile spends her reclaimed storms chaining it into the sky as new constellations. Beat: sacrifice made visible — the stars return, lit by her power.

chapters.title: A Country Made of Roads
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Thornfell re-emerges into the world, no longer hidden; refugees, traders, and the remnant wardens begin mapping it together. Xanthe's erased roads become the official ones. Beat: bittersweet rebuilding, memory restored.

chapters.title: The Last Toll
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Odile declines the empty throne, installs a council, and walks out of Thornfell unnamed — the Hollow King's toll finally repaid with her own forgotten title. Beat: release; identity chosen rather than inherited.

chapters.title: Stars Over the Pass
chapters.summary: Shared POV. On the far side of the pass, under fully returned stars, Odile and Xanthe compare maps of everywhere left to go. Beat: quiet resolution — two people who chose each other over kingdoms, setting out on an open road.
